## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] Tested on **Android and iOS** (low-end Android for list/animation work)
- [ ] Light and dark mode checked; RTL checked if layout changed
- [ ] New user-facing strings added to **all** locale files
- [ ] Loading, empty, error and offline states handled
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or PII in code, logs or analytics
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit, component, or Maestro flow)
- [ ] Docs updated if architecture or conventions changed
